_comment: Single source of truth for pixel geometry shared by tools/preview.py and src/main.cpp. preview.py reads this file at runtime. tools/gen_layout_header.py turns it into src/layout.h (auto-run by `pio run`, see platformio.ini extra_scripts). Edit this file, not the generated header. Colors, fonts, and text content are not layout and stay hardcoded in each file.
_comment_now_strip: Positions reused as-is for src/main.cpp: F_HUGE/F_MED/F_SMALL/F_BIG map to fonts within a few px of these PIL sizes (see the mapping comment above drawHeader() in main.cpp), unlike the wind reading which needed its own firmware_only offsets. Still a first pass -- check on-device.
_comment_firmware_only: Elements only src/main.cpp draws. Not consumed by preview.py.

firmware_only._comment_wind: reading_dy/kt_dy are a first-pass estimate for FreeSansBold18pt7b (42px line height) + FreeSansBold9pt7b (22px), bottom-aligned by line-height difference (42-22=20). Not verified on hardware -- check on-device and adjust.

_comment_preview_only: Elements only tools/preview.py draws (its own PIL font-metric offsets, which differ from the GFXfont ones in firmware_only). Skipped by tools/gen_layout_header.py.
